environment: Full locked Hermes Native agent-automation test suite (648 library + 15 protocol + 3 launcher), all-target cargo check, Windows debug desktop build, rustfmt and diff checks. No live Hermes Gateway or installed Hermes app was used.
notes: A user-armed retry schedules only known rate_limit/upstream_rate_limit failures with a valid future resets_at value. The UI shows a countdown and Cancel; dispatch is one-shot and fenced to the exact session/profile/connection/submission. The timer is ephemeral and is cancelled on owner or draft changes. Billing/usage-window actions, broader error taxonomy and live/packaged acceptance remain open.
